title: Tour the Automation overview
blurb: See at a glance how many people your workflows are reaching each week.

steps.title: Open the Overview
steps.body: The Overview opens from here rather than a tab at the top. If you're not on it yet, click **Take me there**.

steps.title: Enrolments over time
steps.body: **Workflow enrollments - last 7 weeks** shows how many people entered your workflows each week. A sudden drop often means a form or trigger has stopped firing.

steps.title: Next step
steps.body: Next: if a workflow isn't behaving, try **Troubleshoot with execution logs** from the Guide.
